Hmm that gives branch(cond, if_value, else_value=identity). Then x7 = rbind(x6, x4): x6 has 2 args, so rbind fixes second arg: x7(cond) = x6(cond, x4) = branch(cond, x4, identity). So if cond true => x4 (function repeat 3s), else identity.

x10(row) = rapply(x9(row), row) = apply each function in the set to row = (that_function(row),) actually a tuple.

x11 = compose(first, x10): first function applied. So x11(row) = that_function(row).
